query: Who died first, George Archainbaud or Ralph Murphy?

pipeline_result.response:
To determine who died first between George Archainbaud and Ralph Murphy, we need to look at their death dates. According to the provided context:

- George Archainbaud passed away on February 20, 1959.
- Ralph Murphy passed away on February 10, 1967.

Comparing these two dates, Ralph Murphy died earlier than George Archainbaud. Therefore, Ralph Murphy died first.
retrieved_context: George Archainbaud: George Archainbaud (May 7, 1890 – February 20, 1959) was a French-born American film and television director.

Ralph Murphy: Ralph Murphy (May 1, 1895 – February 10, 1967) was an American film director.  Born in Rockville, Connecticut, Murphy was active in films from 1931 through 1962, with some work in television.  From 1941–44 he was married to Gloria Dickson, whom he directed in "I Want a Divorce".
